title: deferred telemetry proxy and on-call coldstart guard
author: Tara Chen
description: Motivation: during on-call handoffs and service restarts we observe noisy, low-signal telemetry and frequent failed snapshot uploads because collectors are still warming. This causes alert noise and gaps in post-incident diagnostics. This PR introduces a lightweight deferred telemetry proxy and coldstart guard for on-call snapshotting to reduce noise and ensure reliable diagnostics. Key behaviors: 1) a telemetry proxy component that temporarily buffers non-critical telemetry exports and replays them after instrument warm-up thresholds are met; 2) on-call coldstart guard for incident snapshotting that defers snapshot attachments for a configurable TTL while periodically probing collectors and sanitizers; 3) idempotent snapshot reattach flow with exponential backoff and metadata-based deduplication to avoid duplicate artifacts; 4) safety and RBAC checks so only authorized on-call roles can request forced immediate snapshots; 5) a small SDK helper (slo-toolkit/collector/warmup) used by incident-bot to signal readiness; 6) docs and migration notes. Implementation notes: the proxy is a process-level sidecar with a tiny in-memory ring buffer and optional persistent queue backing (filesystem) for environments with longer warmups. The warm-up heuristic uses event rate, successful export percentage, and collector health pings. The snapshot deferral workflow attaches a short-lived placeholder to incidents and attempts up to N retry cycles to attach the full artifact. Placeholders are sanitized and marked with provenance. Rollout plan: default behavior off; opt-in via config flag in console and env var SLO_TOOLKIT_DEFERRED_PROXY=1 for private deployments. Includes feature gating, telemetry metrics to monitor deferred message counts and replay success rate, and an emergency bypass for PagerDuty-triggered forced snapshots. Why this is different from previous work: existing PRs suggest auto-runbook and snapshot exporters focused on enrichment; this one specifically targets the coldstart window and failed snapshot attachment surface area with a deferred-retry-first design to reduce noise and increase diagnostic fidelity. Migration & compatibility: backward compatible with current incident attachments and incident-bot hooks; integration tests added to the sim harness to validate failover and reattach scenarios. Rollout recommendation: enable in a small set of teams for 2 weeks and watch deferred_replay_success_rate and oncall_noise_rate. Links: linear ENG-3345 (collector warmup heuristics), ENG-3441 (incident artifact reliability).

release_notes: Add deferred telemetry proxy with coldstart guard to reduce on-call noise and improve reliability of incident snapshot attachments. Feature is off by default; enable via config. Includes metrics 'deferred_replay_success_rate' and 'deferred_placeholder_count' and RBAC for forced snapshot bypass.
